quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Xenops!
quests.question: x
quests.hint: It comes right after W.
quests.explanation: Nice! You found x. It comes right after W.
quests.funFact: The xenops is a rainforest bird that loves to hang upside down while eating!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Yarn!
quests.question: y
quests.hint: This is the letter that starts Yarn. 🧶
quests.explanation: Great job finding y! It has two short lines meeting in the middle, with a tail that dips below.
quests.funFact: A single ball of yarn can contain over 200 yards of wool!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Zipper!
quests.question: z
quests.hint: It comes right after Y.
quests.explanation: Nice! You found z. It comes right after Y.
quests.funFact: The first zippers were used only for boots and tobacco pouches!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Alligator!
quests.question: A
quests.hint: It comes right before B.
quests.explanation: Nice! You found A. It comes right before B.
quests.funFact: Alligators can go through 3,000 teeth in their lifetime!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Butterfly!
quests.question: B
quests.hint: This is the letter that starts Butterfly. ⚽
quests.explanation: Great job finding B! It has a tall straight line with two round bumps stacked on the right.
quests.funFact: Butterflies taste with their feet instead of their mouths!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Castle!
quests.question: C
quests.hint: It comes right after B.
quests.explanation: Nice! You found C. It comes right after B.
quests.funFact: The oldest inhabited castle in the world is Windsor Castle in England!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Drum!
quests.question: d
quests.hint: It has a small circle with a tall straight line on the right side.
quests.explanation: Well done! d is the letter that starts Drum. 🥁
quests.funFact: Drums are the world's oldest and most common musical instruments!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Egg!
quests.question: e
quests.hint: Look for a small circle with a flat line across the middle. That's how Egg starts too.
quests.explanation: That's it! Egg starts with the lowercase letter e. 🥚
quests.funFact: The color of a hen's earlobe can tell you what color egg she will lay!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Firetruck!
quests.question: f
quests.hint: It has a tall line with a small crossbar, like a tiny flagpole.
quests.explanation: Well done! f is the letter that starts Firetruck. 🚒
quests.funFact: Early firetrucks were actually pulled by horses, not engines!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Gorilla!
quests.question: G
quests.hint: It has a big curved line like C, with a small hook at the bottom.
quests.explanation: Well done! G is the letter that starts Gorilla. 🦍
quests.funFact: Gorillas can learn sign language and communicate with humans!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Helicopter!
quests.question: H
quests.hint: Look for two tall straight lines joined by a bridge in the middle. THelicopter's how Helicopter starts too.
quests.explanation: THelicopter's it! Helicopter starts with the uppercase letter H. 🚁
quests.funFact: A helicopter can fly backwards, forwards, and even side-to-side!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Island!
quests.question: I
quests.hint: It has one tall, straight line standing alone.
quests.explanation: Well done! I is the letter that starts Island. 🏝️
quests.funFact: The world's largest island is Greenland!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Jaguar!
quests.question: j
quests.hint: It has a curved hook with a small dot on top.
quests.explanation: Well done! j is the letter that starts Jaguar. 🐆
quests.funFact: Jaguars are excellent swimmers and love to play in the water!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Koala!
quests.question: k
quests.hint: Look for a tall straight line with two small legs kicking out. That's how Koala starts too.
quests.explanation: That's it! Koala starts with the lowercase letter k. 🐨
quests.funFact: Koalas sleep for up to 22 hours a day!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Lizard!
quests.question: l
quests.hint: It has one tall, straight line standing alone.
quests.explanation: Well done! l is the letter that starts Lizard. 🦎
quests.funFact: Some lizards can detach their tails to escape predators, and it grows back later!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Mountain!
quests.question: M
quests.hint: It has two tall lines with a peak dipping down between them, like mountains.
quests.explanation: Well done! M is the letter that starts Mountain. ⛰️
quests.funFact: Mount Everest, the tallest mountain, grows about a quarter of an inch every year!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Nut!
quests.question: N
quests.hint: Look for two tall lines joined by a slanted line between them. That's how Nut starts too.
quests.explanation: That's it! Nut starts with the uppercase letter N. 🥜
quests.funFact: Peanuts aren't actually nuts; they grow underground and are legumes!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Ocean!
quests.question: O
quests.hint: It has a big round circle.
quests.explanation: Well done! O is the letter that starts Ocean. 🌊
quests.funFact: We have explored less than 5% of the world's oceans!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Piano!
quests.question: p
quests.hint: It has a tall line that dips below, with a round bump on top.
quests.explanation: Well done! p is the letter that starts Piano. 🎹
quests.funFact: A standard piano has exactly 88 keys!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Quarter!
quests.question: q
quests.hint: Look for a small circle with a short tail that dips below the line. That's how Quarter starts too.
quests.explanation: That's it! Quarter starts with the lowercase letter q. 🪙
quests.funFact: A US quarter has exactly 119 ridges around its edge!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Rocket!
quests.question: r
quests.hint: It has a short straight line with a small curve at the top.
quests.explanation: Well done! r is the letter that starts Rocket. 🚀
quests.funFact: Rockets have to travel at 25,000 miles per hour to escape Earth's gravity!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Star!
quests.question: S
quests.hint: It has a curvy line that curls one way then the other.
quests.explanation: Well done! S is the letter that starts Star. ⭐
quests.funFact: Some stars you see at night are actually two stars orbiting each other!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Turtle!
quests.question: T
quests.hint: Look for a tall straight line with a flat line across the top, like a hat. That's how Turtle starts too.
quests.explanation: That's it! Turtle starts with the uppercase letter T. 🐢
quests.funFact: Some turtles can live to be over 100 years old!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Universe!
quests.question: U
quests.hint: It has a curved dip with two straight sides, like a little cup.
quests.explanation: Well done! U is the letter that starts Universe. 🌌
quests.funFact: The universe is expanding every second, getting bigger and bigger!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Vampire!
quests.question: v
quests.hint: It has two short lines meeting in a point at the bottom, like a checkmark.
quests.explanation: Well done! v is the letter that starts Vampire. 🧛
quests.funFact: Vampire bats are real, but they mostly just drink the blood of sleeping cows!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Window!
quests.question: w
quests.hint: Look for four short lines dipping up and down, like two v's together. That's how Window starts too.
quests.explanation: That's it! Window starts with the lowercase letter w. 🪟
quests.funFact: Before glass was invented, windows were made of flattened animal horns or paper!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter for Xiphias!
quests.question: x
quests.hint: It has two short lines crossing in the middle.
quests.explanation: Well done! x is the letter that starts Xiphias. 🐟
quests.funFact: Xiphias is the scientific name for a swordfish, which can swim 50 miles per hour!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Yacht!
quests.question: Y
quests.hint: It has two short lines meeting in the middle, sitting on one straight line.
quests.explanation: Well done! Y is the letter that starts Yacht. ⛵
quests.funFact: The word yacht comes from a Dutch word meaning 'hunter'!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Zombie!
quests.question: Z
quests.hint: Look for a zigzag line -- straight, slanted, then straight again. That's how Zombie starts too.
quests.explanation: That's it! Zombie starts with the uppercase letter Z. 🧟
quests.funFact: In nature, there is a real fungus that can turn ants into 'zombie ants'!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter for Airplane!
quests.question: A
quests.hint: It has two slanted lines meeting at the top, with a short line across the middle.
quests.explanation: Well done! A is the letter that starts Airplane. ✈️
quests.funFact: The very first airplane flight lasted only 12 seconds!
